top_posts.text:
look how the earnings tone of moderna $MRNA jumped in the latest release, after a long stretch of flat to negative quarters 
 
that means far more positive words than negative ones in management's own text. they also raised revenue growth guidance to 15%-25%, up from up to 10% before 
 
moderna makes mrna vaccines and sells mostly to governments, so a higher revenue guide matters 
 
$ABBV $AMG

top_posts.author: AdamBrennan2
top_posts.text:
incyte $INCY has a second drug growing fast next to its main one: opzelura net sales are up 35.6% to 255 million 
 
jakafi, the blood cancer drug, still brings in the most and is growing at a much slower pace, up 4.6% in the latest quarter. opzelura is a cream for inflammatory skin conditions 
 
to me this looks like a company slowly lowering its dependence on jakafi, and the numbers show it more

top_posts.author: AdamBrennan2
top_posts.text:
exelixis $EXEL sells its cancer drugs in the u.s. through four middlemen: cencora, mckesson, cvs and accredo 
 
they all carry cabometyx and cometriq, and the page shows 2/5 pricing power for each. so the company depends on a few big buyers 
 
on the other side, bristol myers squibb and genentech co-commercialize its combination regimens
